curatedMovie.curiosityHook: When a studio executive starts receiving death threats from a rejected writer, figuring out which spurned creator is responsible becomes an urgent puzzle.
curatedMovie.description: In Robert Altman's satirical mystery, a powerful Hollywood studio executive begins receiving anonymous death threats from a disgruntled screenwriter whose script he rejected.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: A biting blend of comedy and crime mystery with deliberate pacing, moderate emotional stakes, and steady suspense.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Robert Altman blends sharp industry comedy with a genuine thriller engine, turning Hollywood's cutthroat culture into an engaging, suspenseful guessing game.
